# Spotlight

> Spotlight is a media & marketing intelligence agency. It runs digital marketing, PR & coverage monitoring, creative production and influencer coordination through one connected system — automation on the repetitive pipes, a human approval gate on every decision that matters (publish, spend, send).

Spotlight is organized around four service lines and a small set of operating principles. Content below mirrors the on-page copy so it can be summarized or quoted accurately.

## Services

- **Digital Marketing** (flagship): content calendars built from past performance, on-brand copy drafts, scheduling & publishing across platforms, ad budget pacing recommendations, live client-facing reporting. Final publish and spend approval is always human.
- **PR & Coverage**: trade press & social mention monitoring, daily sentiment digest, journalist-beat matching suggestions. Spotlight never automates pitching a journalist — that stays human.
- **Creative**: auto-resize across platform specs, AI-assisted rough cuts for Reels/Shorts, templated social design. Final polish and brand judgment stay human.
- **Influencer**: data-driven influencer discovery, brief-to-approval deliverable tracking. Negotiation with creators stays human.

## How Spotlight works (operating principles)

1. Pipes, not people — tooling covers data, drafts and monitoring; never pitching, negotiation, or judgment calls.
2. Buy before we build — off-the-shelf tools by default; custom software only where it creates a lasting advantage.
3. Thin, then iterate — ship the smallest useful version and improve from there; no six-month builds.
4. A human approves — every AI-drafted output is labeled a draft until a person on the client's team clicks approve.

## Who it's for

Lean in-house marketing teams, growth-stage brands scaling past founder-led marketing, and multi-brand operators who need one system tracking coverage and deliverables instead of several disconnected spreadsheets.
